items.why: Profit taking after record highs: AMD broke below $620 support as investors rotated out of chips on AI spending doubts, with ARK trimming its stake and memory competition fears weighing on the sector.

Meta rallied on renewed optimism around its Muse AI push and strong core ad growth, with Wells Fargo's $1,000 price target and the new AI glasses lineup from Meta Connect keeping institutional buyers interested.
Crude climbed as Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport and Russian attacks on Ukrainian energy sites kept supply risks in focus, overshadowing Trump's announced energy ceasefire.
Nvidia slid as reports that OpenAI's annualized revenue is lower than earlier figures raised doubts about the sustainability of AI capex, with a sharp rise in Treasury yields adding pressure.

market_note: S&P little changed; Nasdaq lags on chip weakness while energy lifts the Dow; bank earnings kick off Tuesday and CPI lands Wednesday.
summary: Stocks opened the week mixed, with energy leading as oil jumped above $105 on geopolitical headlines, while chip stocks sold off on fresh doubts about AI spending. The Dow held up; the Nasdaq lagged.
